A '''mission''' was undertaken by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="Wild Space" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="ERC" /> during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to investigate a rumor of trouble near<ref name="Wild Space" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="AS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]], at the edge of the civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. At some point during the mission, Mundi attended a [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] meeting via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] alongside his fellow [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], though his holo's connectivity was spotty due to his remote location. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had a vision of Mundi's mission during [[Mission to Zigoola|his travel]] to the planet [[Zigoola]], envisioning that Mundi had nearly been [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Wild Space" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission was first mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Karen Miller]].<ref name="Wild Space" />
